method: Compared risk, logging and URL-fetching claims with Python tempfile, Linux pathname lookup and OWASP SSRF guidance. Ran the offline verifier (8/8); executed the extracted 01-why-isolate path fixture and the duplicated 03-least-privilege fixture. The verifier isolated TMPDIR, created a pre-existing sandbox-demo/preserve.txt sentinel, ran the lesson code, and confirmed the sentinel remained unchanged while the local fixture still produced 4/6. Both lessons’ Python fences compiled. No provider, DNS, HTTP or other external network calls were made.
limitations: The 4/6 result describes only six fixed local path inputs and does not estimate a vulnerability rate or rank production isolation designs.
The realpath/isfile/open example is not race safe and does not validate an OS sandbox, deployment filesystem, multi-tenant boundary, or resource limits.
The URL row describes controls to validate; no URL fetcher, HTTP client, redirect handling, DNS pinning, firewall, or egress policy was exercised.
The temporary directory test verifies this lesson script preserves one pre-existing same-named directory; it is not a general test of tempfile cleanup behavior on every platform.
